title: Which loads coalesce?
summary: Pick the access patterns that use every byte of every sector a warp fetches.

choices.text: `A[t * N + col]`: each lane reads one element of a column.
`A[row * N + t]`: each lane reads one element of a row.
`A[row * N + 32 * blockIdx.x + t]`: a row segment that starts at a multiple of 32 elements.
`A[row * N + 2 * t]`: every other element of a row.
`reinterpret_cast<const float4*>(A)[row * N / 4 + t]`: one `float4` per lane along a row, 512 bytes per warp in 16 sectors, all used.
